sentences.quote: Greg Peters was named co-CEO of Netflix in January 2023. Previously, he served as Chief Operating Officer and Chief Product Officer. Earlier, Greg was International Development Officer for Netflix.
sentences.text: Greg Peters was named co-CEO of Netflix in January 2023, having previously served as Chief Operating Officer and Chief Product Officer and, earlier, as International Development Officer; before joining Netflix in 2008 he was Senior Vice President of consumer electronics products at Macrovision Solutions Corp.

sentences.quote: Macrovision Solutions Corp. (later renamed to Rovi Corporation) and previously held positions at digital entertainment software provider, Mediabolic Inc., Red Hat Network, the provider of Linux and Open Source technology, and online vendor Wine.com
sentences.text: (later Rovi Corporation), and he also held positions at Mediabolic Inc., Red Hat Network and Wine.com.
Netflix's proxy lists him as co-Chief Executive Officer and President of the company and a director since 2023, noting roles of increasing responsibility at Netflix since 2008.
The board cites his understanding of the company's technology and worldwide operations as well as executive leadership experience.
He serves on the board of DoorDash Inc., previously served on the boards of Highland Transcend Partners I Corp.

(later Rovi Corporation), and he also held positions at Mediabolic Inc., Red Hat Network and Wine.com.

sentences.text: Chief content officer Bela Bajaria is leaving Netflix after about a decade, with former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice succeeding her from October 26, 2026, overseeing global content across film, scripted and unscripted series and live events.
The change accompanies a plan announced on October 14, 2026 to cut roughly 1,000 jobs, about 6 percent of staff, mainly in product, technology, legal and human resources.

sentences.quote: "Our mission - to entertain the world - is ambitious, and delivering on it requires us to be disciplined about where we prioritize our people and resources," Netflix co-CEOs Ted Sarandos and Greg Peters wrote
